scope: Fully synthetic geometric motion only, not a cash-action/legal gate or bank quality evaluation

geometry.montage: 2x2 in reading order; same frames and total source pixel area; F labels only

interpretation: T vs TC and V vs VC isolate response_format; VC vs LC tests prompt length/wording on the same physical task; VC vs PC tests packing with equal source pixel area. Actual token counts can differ and are reported. No retries, prompt tuning, TRAIN or previous partial controls.
not_identified: Chat template correctness is not directly rendered/audited
A single4B checkpoint cannot identify model capacity as cause
Generic shapes do not validate cashier roles, service completion, cash handling, legal applicability or bank video quality
stop: One frozen18-call probe. Stop on startup failure, total deadline or native exit; preserve fixed aggregate partial progress. A failed cell is counted, not retried. No legal gate or bank media is run. No raw response/log is emitted or saved.
